why: An attack's state sets 0x400000 in MegaMan's collision flags as it begins and the attack's end clears it, in both games (the spread family's state: BN4 0x080EC7B2-0x080EC7B6, movs r0,#1; lsls r0,#22; bl 0x08012F82, its end 0x0800C9FC's bl 0x08012F8C at 0x0800CA16; BN6's twin family 0x25 at 0x080EDF38-0x080EDF3C, bl 0x0801A152, its end 0x08011714's bl 0x0801A15C at 0x08011750). Where a hit ends the attack instead, the two engines' struck states part: BN6's (his state 3, 0x080174FE) sets 0x400400 as it begins and clears both bits as it ends (0x0801758A: bl 0x0801A15C), so the attack's bit goes with it; BN4's (0x08010960) sets and clears 0x400 alone (0x0801096C-0x08010970, 0x080109DE-0x080109E2), so the attack's bit stands until his next attack ends (the same two states "BN6's MegaMan's paralysis state's flag 0x400000" names, from BN6's side). His struck state in BN6's engine is BN6's own, not the moved unit's. Guarded: that bit alone, BN4's holding it and BN6's not, only while his CurAction is a generic state's in both games (BN4's 6 or under, BN6's 8 or under: in an attack's state the bit is compared as ever, so a moved state that did not set it fails), every other bit of the word compared as ever. bn4_chip_heatshot_struck: HeatShot used at fight frame 88, MegaMan struck by the Mettaur's wave at t97 with his arm out; the bit differs from t120, as his struck state ends, to the spec's end
